current_suggestion.pitch: Rippetoe is the intellectual counterweight to Renaissance Periodization's volume-and-hypertrophy framing — he argues from first principles that strength is the foundational physical adaptation, and his case is more rigorous and philosophically grounded than most give him credit for. Where RP optimizes accessory work and periodization for aesthetics, Rippetoe focuses on barbell training as a biological stressor with a specific stress-recovery-adaptation logic that differs meaningfully from hypertrophy-first thinking. Format is a mix of short solo lectures, Q&A, and coaching breakdowns — dense and opinionated, not motivational.
